what_they_do: Tero connects read-only to a company's existing telemetry stores (Datadog, ClickHouse, S3, CloudWatch, Elastic, GCP Logging) and continuously models what's actually being logged, who owns it, and where it's wasteful, sensitive, or risky. Instead of engineers or agents manually digging through fragmented observability tools to figure out what data means and whether it's safe to act on, Tero pre-investigates the telemetry and exposes it as unified, agent-queryable context, plus policy-based remediation to cut logging volume without touching pipelines.
theme_fit_rationale: Theme 3 explicitly names observability as a category needing agent-native rebuilding. Tero's 'Query' product exists specifically to give AI agents unified, pre-investigated query access across telemetry backends instead of forcing agents to make dozens of blind API calls, and 'Actions' lets agents trigger remediation directly. It's infrastructure built for agents-as-users of observability data, not a human dashboard.
